regions.note: #menuClassName + #menuClassSubtext: Triggerman, the weapon name in the skin's rarity colour. Text antialiasing differs between Chromium and the engine's FreeType (the class-card precedent in main-menu-nowplaying-long.json is 12%); the colour check below is strict
